plan: L72 controls, stated before any controls program exists (lane L72, bead think-qqyg)
stated_from: out/check-n172.json and out/check-n270.json (the frozen checker's receipts)
work/plan-facts-n172.json and work/plan-facts-n270.json (l72_plan_facts.py: exact wall clearances, the side less its 12-place floor, the least pair's centre-line move; no modified file decided)

definitions.contact: a margin or clearance of exactly 0
definitions.past: 1e-30 beyond contact, in the construction's own parameter
definitions.decided_by: file-level controls are decided by l72_check.decide_data (both methods, every square, wall and pair); pair-level and square-level controls by l72_sat and l72_clip directly; reader controls by l72_reader.read_texts
definitions.centre_line_closing: for a pair (i, j), square j is translated by s d with d = c_i - c_j (centres c = (p0 + p2)/2); s* is the least s at which the exact margin reaches 0, computed from the four axes' linear gap functions; contact is s*, past is s* + 1e-30
definitions.enlargement: square j scaled about its centre by lambda; lambda* is the least lambda > 1 at which its exact margin with i reaches 0; contact lambda*, past lambda* + 1e-30; margins on j's own unit axes
definitions.nearest_wall: the wall of least clearance, ties broken left, right, bottom, top
definitions.reflection: each square reflected in its own horizontal centre line: (x, y) -> (x, 2 c_y - y), which reads the rotation the other way and keeps each square's bounding box
